positive_styles: gentle Brazilian children's song for babies and toddlers, peekaboo hide-and-seek game song
the same warm young adult female lead singer throughout the whole song, identical voice, timbre and vocal register in every section, sweet and clear, natural Brazilian Portuguese
small soft group of backing voices answering 'Achou!' and 'au, au!'
light percussion: shaker, soft hand claps, soft kick
clean modern production, studio quality, clear intelligible lyrics, lead vocal upfront in the mix
two small soft dog barks at the end

chunks.text:
[Chorus]
Cadê, cadê, cadê você?
Cadê, cadê, quem vai aparecer?
Tem alguém escondidinho no jardim,
Vem procurar bem juntinho de mim!

chunks.text:

Atrás da flor, quem será?

ACHOU!
(Au, au!)
